title: Süper İşler Takımı Tatlı Bir Macera
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: Red Dino and Whirling Storm embark on an adventure full of sweets, but the world of sweets is not as innocent as it seems. In the Land of Sweets, Red Dino gains new superpowers and learns the dark secrets of refined sugar and why he should avoid foods that are bad for his health.
original_title: Süper İşler Takımı Tatlı Bir Macera
